text:
Alyssa: Heads up — our embeddings blackbox checks in us-west2 are firing a lot overnight. Latency is fine but cost is spiking. Thinking we should reduce sampling during low-traffic windows and stop creating GPU-backed jobs for every probe run.

Mike: Agree on lowering sampling. Do we have the current cost-per-probe calc? I remember ~ $0.003 per embedding probe when it cold-starts a GPU pod. :grimacing:

Sam: That matches my numbers — coldstart + containerimage pull dominates. If probes hit dedicated pools we also see queueing. Proposal: 1) switch embeddings synthetic to lightweight HTTP-only probe that hits a cached proxy, 2) reduce rate to 1/min per region during 00:00-06:00, 3) keep the full GPU e2e check every 30m.

Nora: Nice. How would the cached proxy work? We need to ensure it still exercises the inference path enough for SLOs; can't skip KV cache priming checks entirely.

Sam: The proxy returns a cached embedding for a fixed prefix unless you add header `X-E2E-Test: true`. So normal cheap probe => quick, cheap. The expensive probe toggles header to bypass cache and exercise model. Example probe config: 
```yaml
- name: embeddings-cheap
  interval: 60s
  url: https://probe-proxy.us-west2.redwood.internal/embeddings?model=all
  headers:
    - name: X-Probe-Mode
      value: cached
- name: embeddings-e2e
  interval: 1800s
  url: https://inference.us-west2.redwood.internal/embeddings
  headers:
    - name: X-Probe-Mode
      value: e2e
```

Ravi: If we do that we must update Prometheus relabeling to not drop the e2e metrics. Currently relabeler has `job=blackbox` -> `drop if probe==cheap` in us-west2. I'll update the relabel rules. Also suggest adding a label `probe_tier=cheap|e2e`.

Mike: Grafana dash needs a panel for probe-cost and probe-coverage. Add a derived metric: `probe_cost_usd_total` via recording rule = sum(probe_runs_total{probe_tier="e2e"} * 0.003) by (region). Then show cost smoothed by 6h.

Alyssa: Good call. Also noticed false positives when regional control plane is quiet — we get 503s but the model is fine. Those are correlated with SNAT port exhaustion events. Any ideas to avoid alert noise?

Nora: We can add a conditional alert: only fire SLO error if both blackbox probe fails AND either (1) synthetic trace shows SDK handshake failures OR (2) k8s node condition `NetworkUnavailable` is set for >1m. That reduces noise from transient SNAT.

Sam: Implemented a promql alert draft: 
```promql
sum_over_time((probe_success == 0) and on(region) group_left() (kube_node_status_condition{condition="NetworkUnavailable"}==1)[5m:]) > 0
```
Not perfect but reduces cases.

Ravi: Also we should tune alert severity. Cheap proxy failures -> `info`, e2e failures -> `p1` if they persist >5m. That buys on-call time.

ci-bot: Deploy queued: update `blackbox-config` relabel rules and `probe-rates` config. CI pipeline #bld-3782. :package:

Mike: Before we deploy, can someone sanity-check the RBAC for the probe proxy? We had an incident where probes couldn't hit the proxy because of a missing net-pol.

Alyssa: I'll run a local sim tonight (00:15 UTC) against staging us-west2. Will post results. If all good, schedule deploy for 02:00. :thumbsup:

Nora: One more thought — create a Grafana alert for probe-coverage < 90% of regions over 24h. That ensures we don't blind ourselves by dropping probes too aggressively to save costs.

Sam: Agreed. I'll add a dashboard panel and a recording rule for `region_probe_coverage_ratio`.

Alyssa: Thanks all. Action items: Sam update probe config + dashboard PR, Ravi update relabel rules and alert severities, Nora add coverage alert, Mike cost panel, I'll run staging test and deploy if green.

Mike: :rocket:

ci-bot: Deployment started: bld-3782 -> staging at 1967894500

Alyssa: staging run passed for cheap probes, e2e test failed once due to a transient image pull. Rerun queued.

Ravi: Merged relabel change. Will monitor SNAT metrics next 6h and adjust thresholds.

Alyssa: Thanks — will follow up with a short postmortem if we see repeated noise.
